summary: BalanceIndicator was updated to show an additional English-labeled “Admin Wallet” balance (PKR) for authenticated admin users, and react-query hooks were added/updated to check admin status, fetch admin wallet balance only when admin, and refetch balances after distributions. One key resilience requirement is not fully met: if the admin-wallet fetch fails for an admin user, the UI still renders the admin-wallet section and falls back to showing 0 rather than treating the admin-wallet data as unavailable and hiding that section.

missing_requirements.requirement: If the admin wallet fetch fails for any reason (network/actor not ready), the BalanceIndicator still renders the caller balance and the page remains usable, and it should treat admin-wallet data as unavailable and simply not render the admin-wallet portion of the UI.
missing_requirements.reason: The admin-wallet UI section is shown whenever `showAdminWallet` is true (authenticated and `isAdmin === true`), regardless of whether the admin wallet query errors. Additionally, `displayAdminBalance` defaults to `BigInt(0)` when `adminWalletBalance` is undefined, so on error it will still render an “Admin Wallet” section with a 0 value rather than hiding that section as “unavailable.”
